QuestInfo.name: Demon Fury Training 1
QuestInfo.0: You have lost most of your power. Even your Demon Fury's is weak, and hard to control. You need to train it back up.
QuestInfo.1: Practice charging your Demon Fury by landing normal attacks. Once it is charged, use an attack skill such as #b#q31001000##k. Use #b#q31001000##k to eliminate 1 #r1 #o9300409## inside #b#m310010100##k. To use #b#q31001000##k, open your Skill Inventory (Hotkey: K) and select the skill.
QuestInfo.2: You managed to charge up your Demon Fury, and eliminate some foes by using it. Better keep practicing, just in case.

0.0: Most of my powers have disappeared. Even my Demon Fury is weaker than it once was...and I can barely control what I have. If I am to become great again, I must first master my Demon Fury.

yes.0: I should start by charging my Demon Fury. I believe I just have to use regular attacks to do that. Perhaps I'll start by eliminating #r1 #o9300409##k at #b#m310010100##k.

no.0: I cannot believe I have to do such basic training...how the mighty have fallen. I'll start later.

yes.0: My control is returning. I should try using my Fury seriously.

default.0: As I land regular attacks, I can feel my Fury building...as if I were filling a gauge of some sort. I should try 'filling' this 'gauge' and using one of my special skills. Now, what shall I destroy with my demonic power...? Ah, #r1 #o9300409## at #b#m310010100##k should be perfect.
